description: Source code for RoadmapRepository class managing database operations for Roadmap entities, including create, list, get, update, and delete methods.

classes.name: RoadmapRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling database operations related to Roadmap objects.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Roadmap entry with validated fields, serializes graph payload, and adds it to the session.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of Roadmaps, optionally filtered by user_identifier, ordered by updated_at descending.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a Roadmap by ID, optionally ensuring ownership by user_identifier.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates mutable fields of a Roadmap, including name, graph_payload, and notes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Roadmap from the database session.
